check.rule: faithful iff (a) at 12: the v3 GNN stack vs k5_rf5 + MWWk on the 16 monitor world-episodes x replicates 0 / 1, g >= -F (M5's floors) and no more deaths (Stage I's rule); (b) at 42: on CHECK_42_WORLDS at horizon 200 (4 episodes, stage m6-drain, replicates 0 / 1), the producers past the sustainable ceiling at episode end, summed, are no more than the base's, and the units are not below the base's beyond the floor (L5's mean_comp floor); (c) the v3 stack vs the EXP-0100 stack on the monitor set, g >= -F. Else short, naming the clauses

held_out_of_fit.orderer: orderer samples kept whole (the gate is the producer's)
held_out_of_fit.rule: COLLECT_42_WORLDS[::6], both episodes (blocks of 2 x 4200 decisions in world order)

data.reuse: EXP-0105's collect, only at these SHA-256s

decision: supervisor 2026-11-06 after EXP-0106 (DIAGNOSTICS 33: the gate learns the ceiling smoothly; a non-zero boundary rate compounds into irreversible upgrades)

feature.added: 1[margin < 0] next to the v3 margin (m6_gnn.v3_to_v4 on recorded v3 features)

fit.mode_rule: auto: before the fit, one epoch of each mode on the full training samples (hogwild first, then sync; fresh models, the same seed); sync if its epoch costs <= sync_max_cost x hogwild's, else hogwild (with clipping); the mode and both times recorded in spec.json

gate.measured_by: m6_gate_probe.model_stats (fire / accuracy at margin < 0 and >= 0, per-head accuracy)

keeps.note: v1..v5 stay frozen; the critic-free Stage 0 becomes v7

loss.boundary_weight_rule: per size s, w_s = #(decisions with upgrade-row margin >= 0 and upgrade label 1) / #(decisions with margin < 0 and upgrade label 0) on the v4 training samples of size s; the upgrade gate's BCE term of each margin < 0, label-0 decision is weighted w_s, every other term 1. It equalises per size the total weight of the two error types the gate must separate (firing at margin < 0, missing a legitimate upgrade), with no free constant

rule: step 1 (offline gate, on recorded k5_rf5 decisions: the 12-producer monitor set and the 42-producer GATE_42_WORLDS held out of the fit): pass iff the v4 upgrade fire rate at margin < 0 is <= 1% at both sizes, the upgrade accuracy at margin >= 0 on the 12 monitor set is >= v2's (EXP-0100) - 0.02, and the restore and expand accuracies are >= v2's at both sizes; else gate_fail (stop, no closed-loop run). step 2 (only after a pass): EXP-0105's three-clause check (V3_RULE) unchanged with the v4 models: faithful or short naming the clauses
stage: Stage I v4: the margin's sign as a step input, a boundary-weighted upgrade gate
